system.description:
Requirements: Shield Expert, Training (2) in Melee Weapons

You have learned to use your shield for both offense and defense.

  • Once per turn, if you take the Attack action while you have a shield raised, you can attempt to Shove a creature within 1 space of you as a Free Action.

  • If you are not Stunned or Incapacitated, you can add bonus dice equal to your shield's Defense bonus to your Reflexes checks. This includes the bonus to Defense gained from Shield Expert.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.s3gulrmHUVC2dOnE]{Shield Master}
